2607.19524.title: SynPre-FL: Synthetic data-driven pretraining integrated Federated Learning training framework
2607.19524.paper_summary: Federated learning (FL) offers a promising approach to privacy-preserving clinical risk prediction, but its deployment remains limited by restricted data sharing, client heterogeneity, class imbalance, and the lack of realistic tabular electronic health record (EHR) benchmarks. Synthetic data generation may alleviate data scarcity, yet its integration with federated optimisation has received limited systematic study. We propose SynPre-FL, a unified framework combining high-fidelity synthetic EHR generation with synthetic-pretrained FL for robust prediction under non-IID conditions. A latent autoencoder-diffusion model generates privacy-preserving synthetic cohorts, which are used to warm-start federated training. This pretraining is followed by heterogeneity-aware optimisation using class-balanced local objectives, proximal regularisation, and adaptive server aggregation. Post-hoc calibration and federated-safe explainability support reliable and interpretable risk estimates. Experiments show that the synthetic generator preserves univariate, bivariate, and multivariate structure while protecting against membership-inference and reconstruction attacks. The generated data achieve strong downstream utility under TSTR, TRTS, and model-based evaluations. Across federated settings with 5, 10, and 15 heterogeneous clients, SynPre-FL consistently improves robustness and scalability over baseline methods, especially under severe non-IID fragmentation. Calibration improves probability reliability, while SHAP analysis produces stable and clinically coherent feature attributions across federation sizes. SynPre-FL therefore provides a practical and reproducible framework for combining synthetic data with FL to enable privacy-aware, interpretable, and robust clinical prediction from distributed tabular EHR data.
2607.19524.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習（FL）提供了一種有前景的隱私保護臨床風險預測方法，但其部署仍受到數據共享限制、客戶異質性、類別不平衡以及缺乏現實的表格電子健康記錄（EHR）基準的限制。合成數據生成可能緩解數據稀缺問題，但其與聯邦優化的整合尚未受到系統性的研究。我們提出了SynPre-FL，一個統一框架，結合高保真合成EHR生成與合成預訓練FL，以在非獨立同分佈條件下進行穩健預測。一個潛在自編碼器-擴散模型生成隱私保護的合成群體，這些群體用於熱啟動聯邦訓練。這一預訓練隨後進行異質性感知優化，使用類別平衡的本地目標、近端正則化和自適應服務器聚合。事後校準和聯邦安全解釋支持可靠且可解釋的風險估計。實驗顯示，合成生成器在保護成員推斷和重建攻擊的同時，保留了單變量、雙變量和多變量結構。生成的數據在TSTR、TRTS和基於模型的評估中實現了強大的下游效用。在擁有5、10和15個異質客戶的聯邦環境中，SynPre-FL在穩健性和可擴展性方面始終優於基準方法，特別是在嚴重的非IID碎片化情況下。校準提高了概率可靠性，而SHAP分析在不同聯邦規模中產生穩定且臨床一致的特徵歸因。因此，SynPre-FL提供了一個實用且可重複的框架，用於將合成數據與FL結合，以實現基於分佈式表格EHR數據的隱私意識、可解釋和穩健的臨床預測。
